transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in to see me today?

Um… mostly I’m just having a hard time keeping things organized. Like, between schoolwork and this small accessories shop I’m trying to do, everything kind of ends up in piles—supplies, receipts, due dates, assignment notes. I don’t really know what to deal with first, and it’s been getting overwhelming.
Have you noticed this kind of difficulty staying organized and focused going back to when you were a kid or in school growing up, or is this something that's really only started recently?

Yeah… I think it goes back pretty far. My mom still has some notes from elementary school where teachers said I was out of my seat a lot, talking before I was called on, and rushing through group stuff even when I knew the work. So… not totally new.
Do you still notice yourself feeling restless, interrupting others, or acting impulsively in your day-to-day life now, as an adult?

Yeah… mostly the restless part. Even if I’m not actually doing anything or going anywhere, I feel like my body’s kind of buzzing, like I need to move. It’s worse when I’m supposed to just sit still and listen.
Do you often find yourself losing focus or drifting off partway through tasks, like reading, studying, or working on your shop's paperwork, even when you're trying to concentrate?

Yeah… that happens. Like in class, or if I’m watching a video for business stuff, I’ll start out listening, but then a few minutes later I’m thinking about charm designs or order ideas. Then I realize I missed a big part of what they said.

Would you say these attention and restlessness issues cause real problems for you in more than one area of your life—like both at school and with running your shop, or even in your relationships—not just in one specific setting?

Yeah… it’s not just one place. School has been a problem—I missed some required steps for my program, and now my financial aid is kind of at risk. And with my shop stuff, people I work with on projects have started relying on me less, I think. So… yeah, it’s affecting more than one area.
Thinking back, can you recall specific examples of these attention or restlessness difficulties causing problems before you turned 12 years old?

Um… yeah, I think so. My mom kept some notes from elementary school, and they said stuff like I was always getting out of my seat, talking before I was called on… and rushing through group activities, even when I knew what I was doing.

Have you noticed these concentration and restlessness issues happening during specific periods, like when you're feeling unusually sad, anxious, or using any substances, or are they pretty much constant regardless of your mood?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed a clear pattern like that… it just kind of happens. I guess it’s not only when I’m in a certain mood.
